sentences.text: Rogue is a fictional superhero appearing in American comic books published by Marvel Comics , commonly in association with the X-Men .	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	X-Men	X-Men	superhero	superhero	Marvel	Marvel Comics

The character debuted in Avengers Annual # 10 -LRB- November 1981 -RRB- as a villain , but then soon after she joined the X-Men .	Avengers Annual	The Avengers (comic book)	1981	1981 in comics	X-Men	X-Men	November 1981	1981 in comics
Rogue is part of a subspecies of humans called mutants , who are born with superhuman abilities .
Rogue has the involuntary ability to absorb and sometimes also remove the memories , physical strength , and superpowers of anyone she touches .
Therefore , Rogue considers her powers to be a curse .
For most of her life , she limited her physical contact with others , including her on-off love interest , Gambit .	Gambit	Gambit (comics)
However , after many years , Rogue finally gained full control over her mutant ability .	mutant	Mutant (Marvel Comics)

Hailing from the fictional Caldecott County , Mississippi , Rogue is the X-Men 's self-described southern belle .	Caldecott County	List of fictional counties	Mississippi	Mississippi	X-Men	X-Men	southern belle	southern belle

A runaway , she was adopted by Mystique of the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants and grew up as a villain .	Brotherhood of Evil Mutants	Brotherhood of Mutants	runaway	runaway youth	Mystique	Mystique (comics)

After Rogue permanently absorbs Ms. Marvel 's psyche and Kree powers , she reforms and turns to the X-Men , fearing for her sanity .	X-Men	X-Men	Ms. Marvel	Carol Danvers	Kree	Kree	Marvel	Marvel Comics
Rogue 's real name and early history were not revealed until nearly 20 years after her introduction .
Until the back story provided by Robert Rodi in the ongoing Rogue series , which began in September 2004 , Rogue 's background was only hinted at .	Robert Rodi	Robert Rodi
Her name was revealed as Anna Marie , although her surname is still unknown .
She has sometimes adopted the name Raven , which is the first name of her foster mother Mystique .	Mystique	Mystique (comics)
Rogue has been one of the most prominent members of the X-Men since the 1980s .	X-Men	X-Men

She was # 5 on IGN 's Top 25 X-Men list for 2006 , # 4 on their Top Ten X-Babes list for 2006 , # 3 on Marvel 's list of Top 10 Toughest Females for 2009 and was given title of # 1 X-Man on CBR 's Top 50 X-Men of All Time for 2008 .	X-Men	X-Men	IGN	IGN	Marvel	Marvel Comics	CBR	Comic Book Resources
She was ranked tenth in Comics Buyer 's Guide 's `` 100 Sexiest Women in Comics '' list .
Rogue has been featured in most of the X-Men animated series , and various video games .	X-Men	X-Men	X-Men animated series	X-Men in other media#Team line-ups/compositions
In the X-Men film series , she is portrayed by Anna Paquin .	X-Men	X-Men	Anna Paquin	Anna Paquin
Her visual cue is often the white streak that runs through her hair .
